basics.campus: Knowledge Park II, Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh); IILM also has a university campus in Gurugram
basics.other: Management (BBA, MBA, PGDM), engineering (B.Tech CSE, ECE, AI & Robotics, IT, Mechanical), law, journalism, psychology and liberal arts

admission: B.Tech (CSE, ECE, AI & Robotics, IT, ME)
Class 12 with 50% (45% for SC/ST) in the required subject combination, passed without grace marks
JEE or CUET rank, or IILM's online test and a personal interview
BBA, BA LL.B., BBA LL.B. and other UG
Shortlisting on CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT or NMAT, then a personal interview

scholarships.text: B.Tech merit scholarships of 10% to 30% of tuition based on JEE Main score, merit-cum-means tuition waivers for UG, a 20% sports scholarship, and MBA scholarships of up to 100% on CAT or XAT percentile. The 2026 scholarship deadline was 31 August.

hostel.text: Separate on-campus hostels for boys and girls.

fees.text: IILM lists fees programme-wise. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
